item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs yang gsang gab pa dgu 'grel las khro bo 'bum pa dbang chen gyi gzhung
item.coloph: sgrub thabs kyi rgyal po gab pa dgu 'grel las khro bo 'bum pa dbang chen zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ u ya rgya a ye rgya u tra rgya e ka rgya ag tham rgya sa ma yargya rgya rgya/ 'chi med yum sras gsum gyi man ngag gsang 'dus stag la'i mdzad srol/ lha klu mi snang mdog bzhi'i dngos grub/ rig 'dzin grub thob brgyad cu'i spyod yul/ bla chen yab sras tshogs kyi lung don/ sems dpa' rje blon stang gsum spyi don smar ro//
